deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 29% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.8% = 10-year Treasury 4.8% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 42% last year; 27%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 13% (3 years ago -0%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $13 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 11% (3 years ago 0%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $246M, down 12% from a year ago — about 1% of the last 12 months of sales.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 57% vs quarterly sales up 45% (days of inventory 149 → 169). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 27%/yr over 3 years and 25%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 18% vs a 5-year range of -2–22% (median 8%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).
deeper.margin_position: near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back)

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $221M to shareholders over the last 12 months ($221M buybacks + $0M dividends) = 0.0% of the company's market value. Share count up 1.2% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $17.65, up 15% in 90 days (up 12% in the last 30); 10 analysts raised, 1 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $8.09, up 7% in 90 days (up 6% in the last 30); 8 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Vs peers
deeper.text: Compared with 6 peers (NVDA, INTC, AVGO, QCOM, MRVL, ARM): sales growth 42% vs a median of 27%; operating margin 18% vs 18%; price/sales 16.2× vs 14.0×.

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Data Center 64% of sales, up 97%; Client and Gaming 28% of sales, down 8%; Embedded 8% of sales, up 29%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

deeper.title: Insider trading
deeper.text: Last 90 days: no open-market purchases; sales $114.9M, 93% under pre-set 10b5-1 trading plans. Source: SEC Form 4.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +74% vs a year ago · $4.59 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 74% vs sales 45%: profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 5 quarters running, by growing margins (0% → 8%): analysts keep underestimating it.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.read: Sales up 45% from a year ago and speeding up (from 38% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Growth of quarterly sales (revenue) compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $18 of operating profit, up from $9 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 93% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 97× last year's profit (lower than 62% of the last 5 years; above peers' 47); only 25× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Feb 2; analysts expect EPS of $2.93, up 91% from a year ago. It usually moves about 8% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: Management's outlook is roughly in line with what analysts expected.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects next, from its 8-K earnings release; compared with consensus where available.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
tiles.read: Next year's EPS forecast is up 15% in 90 days (10 raised, 1 cut lately): forecasts are moving up fast.
tiles.explain: How the average analyst forecast for next year's earnings per share changed (Yahoo, unofficial).
